# EO2Weave (怡氧®AI)

> AI-native creator workspace: local-first files, knowledge workflows, and
> multi-agent orchestration. Available as a web app and as a Chrome/Edge browser
> extension. Running a task sends the content that task needs to the AI model
> service handling it.

怡氧®AI 是面向创作者的 AI 原生工作台，提供网页应用与 Chrome/Edge 浏览器扩展两种入口。

The two deployments share one codebase but not one model setup: the China site
(weave.eo2suite.cn) offers built-in models through a Nutstore account, while the
international site (weave.eo2suite.com) expects a provider and API key you
configure yourself. Some pages exist on only one deployment; the links below say
which.

Workspaces are not a cloud copy. Documents live in the browser's OPFS, or on
local disk when the optional native host is installed. What a deployment
collects, and how long it keeps it, is set out in that deployment's privacy
policy rather than summarised here.

## Docs

- [快速开始](https://weave.eo2suite.cn/docs/zh/user/getting-started): 创建第一个项目、发起第一次对话、安装浏览器扩展
- [Getting started](https://weave.eo2suite.com/docs/en/user/getting-started): first project, first conversation, installing the extension
- [Model setup](https://weave.eo2suite.com/docs/en/user/model-setup): configuring a provider, endpoint and API key — required on the international site
- [Workspace and files](https://weave.eo2suite.com/docs/en/user/workspace): how projects, OPFS storage and local disk relate
- [Backup](https://weave.eo2suite.com/docs/en/user/backup): exporting a project folder, or the whole workspace
- [Built-in skills](https://weave.eo2suite.com/docs/en/user/builtin-skills): what ships with the app before you add anything
- [Docs index (EN)](https://weave.eo2suite.com/docs/en) · [文档中心](https://weave.eo2suite.cn/docs/zh)

## Product

- [Download](https://weave.eo2suite.com/download): browser extension for Chrome and Edge
- [WebMCP](https://weave.eo2suite.com/webmcp): the app's own page exposes its capabilities as WebMCP tools, so an external agent can create projects, read and write workspace files, and drive the built-in agent once the user authorizes it

- [Privacy policy (China)](https://weave.eo2suite.cn/help/privacy)
- [Privacy policy (international)](https://weave.eo2suite.com/help/privacy)
